lq.q: What is the main purpose of Practice Session 13 on ethical human conduct?
answer: The main purpose of Practice Session 13 is to help students explore ethical human conduct through real-life situations. Ethical conduct is not only about following rules, codes or punishments. It is based on right understanding, natural acceptance and the ability to see what is mutually fulfilling. In this practice session, students can examine situations where there is an ethical dilemma and identify whether their decision is based on preconditioning, fear, reward, punishment or right understanding. The session helps students see that ethical conduct is definite, self-satisfying, people-friendly and eco-friendly. It also helps them understand that ethical competence must be developed within the individual through self-exploration.
